title: backlog.py runs --reconcile run from another working tree of the repository writes failed or released over the run key of an item whose worker still runs
goal: backlog.py runs [SP|ID] and runs --reconcile, run from any working tree or clone of the repository, read a worker as alive when its dispatching session still runs it: they never write failed or released over the run key of an item whose worker runs or whose claim another tree holds, while an item with no worker recorded anywhere still reconciles to failed

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob, time, signal
from pathlib import Path
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a, cwd=None, e=None): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd or T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=e or env)
g = lambda *a, cwd=None: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a, cwd=cwd)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
def bl(*a, root=None, e=None): return sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', root or T, *a, cwd=root or T, e=e)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Live elsewhere', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
    d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
    if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
    if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = 'todo'; d['sprint'] = sp
    json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted sprint')
bl('claim', iid, '--by', 'check')
g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'claim ' + iid)
T2 = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'other-tree')
g('worktree', 'add', '-q', '--detach', T2)
bd = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); pidfile = bd / 'pid'
(bd / 'claude').write_text('#!' + sys.executable + '\nimport os, sys, time\nsys.stdin.read()\nopen(%r, "w").write(str(os.getpid()))\ntime.sleep(60)\n' % str(pidfile))
(bd / 'claude').chmod(0o755)
pid = None
try:
    bl('dispatch', iid, '--detach', e=dict(env, PATH=str(bd) + os.pathsep + env['PATH']))
    for _ in range(100):
        if pidfile.exists() and pidfile.read_text().strip():
            pid = int(pidfile.read_text().strip()); break
        time.sleep(0.2)
    for _ in range(100):
        before = c('get', 'run/' + iid).stdout
        if 'working' in before: break
        time.sleep(0.2)
    other = bl('runs', sp, '--reconcile', root=T2)
    after = c('get', 'run/' + iid).stdout
finally:
    if pid:
        try: os.kill(pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        except OSError: pass
ok = pid is not None and 'working' in before and 'working' in after and 'failed' not in after and 'released' not in after and other.returncode == 0
print('worker pid', pid, '| run key before', 'working' in before, '| after reconcile from another working tree of the same repository:', after.strip()[-60:], '| exit', other.returncode)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
